events.text: A runaway child follows you, begging to be taught martial arts.

choices.text: Take them home to their family

effects.log: A worried mother and a sulking child. Right thing.

choices.text: Teach them one stance, then take them home

effects.log: They practise it for years.

events.text: A seven-year-old beats a grown fighter in the market square.

effects.log: Nobody. They watched the soldiers. A true prodigy.

choices.text: Warn their parents about jealous sects

effects.log: The family moves somewhere quiet.

events.text: The orphanage is overcrowded after a hard year.

effects.log: Beds for ten more children. (−10 taels)

choices.text: Teach the orphans for a season

effects.log: They look at you like a hero.

events.text: A gang of child thieves is run by a cruel adult.

ok.log: The adult is jailed. The children are free.

fail.log: He escapes, but the children come to you.

effects.log: Slowly, justice.

events.text: A blacksmith's child wants to be a swordsman but must learn smithing.

choices.text: Tell them a smith who can fight is rare

effects.log: They make you a sword someday.
He lets the child train in the evenings.

events.text: A child is lost in the forest overnight.

ok.log: Found by the stream, cold and brave.

fail.log: Found at dawn, by someone else. Everyone is safe.

effects.log: Dozens of lanterns. Found by midnight.

events.text: A child asks: 'Did you always want to be what you are?'

effects.log: The child listens very carefully.
The child thinks about it for days.

events.text: Watching children play, you remember being small.

effects.log: For an hour, you are eight again.
How far you have come.

events.text: You save a kitten from a well. The village calls you a hero.

effects.log: Heroes are modest, you have heard.
The story grows. The kitten was a tiger by evening.

events.text: A new child in the village has no friends.

effects.log: Your best friend for years.
Soon they have many friends.

events.text: A great tree where generations of children carved their names.

effects.log: Some belong to famous fighters.

choices.text: Carve a new name for a child

effects.log: They are delighted.

events.text: The town holds a festival for children: games, sweets and a tiny tournament.

effects.log: Every child wins something.
Sticky and exhausting.
